entries.basis: closed diffuse room with one rectangle; the polished half's reflections and the block contact regions carry the p99
64 rectangles by LTC fits (Heitz et al. 2016) carry fitting error on the glossy stripes and grazing strips
direct light is exact by the contract; p99 is the cookie's mullion edges and the pillar's shadow edge under a filtered atlas lookup
one sun and a sky; p99 is cascade shadow edges and the sun's 0.53 degree penumbra
froxel single scattering against a path-traced homogeneous medium; 256 point and spot lights
screen-space hits against traced reflections, off-screen and occluded rays falling back to probes
the BRDF against Cycles' Principled BSDF on smooth spheres; highlights of the key rectangle carry the p99
derived legacy materials and textures (legacy_bsp_scene.py), modern points of the surface model
derived legacy materials, $ssbump as normal and occlusion, modern points of the surface model

two rooms joined through an elliptical portal opening: direct light through the opening is exact by the contract; p99 is the opening's edge, the post's shadow edge carried through the pair and the polished floor's reflection of what comes through

a rectangle and a spot through a doorway, the door a mover the bake never saw: the indirect layer stays as baked open (the door's own change to it is not modelled) and the spot's shadow edge under a filtered atlas lookup carry the error

the runtime direct diffuse light alone against Cycles' DiffDir x DiffCol: exact without shadows (LTC rectangles, a spot), so the door's and the doorway's shadow edges under a filtered atlas lookup carry the p99

metric: manifest.json error_metric: e = max channel |lab - ref| / mean reference luminance over the judged pixels
rules: An entry is fixed before any comparison uses it and is never edited: its digest covers fixture, version, mean, p99 and fixed.
A changed tolerance is a new version with a later `fixed` time and a `reason`; a version fixed after a recorded comparison of its fixture without a reason is rejected by `lighting_fixtures.py check`.
A comparison records the version and digest it used; one whose tolerance was fixed after it, or changed since, is rejected.
Comparisons against preview references (16 samples) are diagnostic and certify nothing.
